density.report: Tree's density is a row density in 1.0: xs, sm (the default, as compact was) or md (as standard was) or lg.

onOpen.report: Tree's onOpen is onAction in 1.0, with the same item and { preview }; a TreeItem's detail is description and its trailing is end, which the codemod can't see in the data, so TypeScript points at them.
